name: Alfred de Musset
biography: Presented as a representative of Byron's French reception, blaming Byron for not being consoled out of his melancholy, and pairing Byron with Goethe (understood narrowly, via Werther) as co-instillers of 'the poison of melancholy' into French poetry.
